verdict.rationale: Navan's pricing page confirms it can 'manage expenses and issue reimbursements' and the API supports repayments/adjustments, showing the capability exists, but there is no evidence describing direct-deposit payout speed (days) or end-to-end tracking from submission to payout. missing for 10: direct deposit timing/SLA evidence, submission-to-payout tracking/status UI, employee-facing reimbursement workflow details.
